frame: a plain round running track seen from straight above with one runner.
sentence_nl: Hij loopt met de klok mee, maar zij loopt tegen de klok in.
sentence_en: He runs clockwise, but she runs anticlockwise.

frame: one plain mug with a handle on a plain table, front view, plain wall behind, same size on the page. Only this card is drawn here: the mug upside down. Its upright partner rechtop is drawn in Bijwoorden.
sentence_nl: Eerst staat de beker rechtop, maar nu staat hij op zijn kop.
sentence_en: First the mug stands upright, but now it stands upside down.

frame: one adult on a plain bicycle, side view, riding to the right along a flat road line, one plain tree beside the road, same size on the page. Only the direction of the wind relative to the rider changes, shown by long curved wind lines, the bend of the tree and the flap of the jacket.
sentence_nl: Met de wind mee fietsen we snel, maar tegen de wind in is het zwaar.
sentence_en: With the wind behind us we cycle fast, but into the wind it is hard.

frame: five plain wooden toy blocks of the same size, no letters or marks on them, lying on a plain table, front view, same blocks and same size on the page. Only how the blocks lie changes.
sentence_nl: De blokken staan op een rij, maar later liggen ze door elkaar.
sentence_en: The blocks stand in a row, but later they lie jumbled up.

frame: one plain whole round apple on a plain wooden board with a plain knife lying beside it, front view, same board and same size on the page. Only how the apple is cut changes.
sentence_nl: Hij snijdt de appel in tweeën, maar zij snijdt de appel in stukjes.
sentence_en: He cuts the apple in two, but she cuts the apple into little pieces.
